caseName: United Steelworkers of America v. Weber
caseNameFull: United Steelworkers of America, AFL-CIO-CLC v. Weber Kaiser Aluminum & Chemical Corp. v. Weber and United States v. Weber

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 439 U. S. 1045.] Motion of Rudy Gorden et al. for leave to intervene and for an order vacating the judgment below and remanding cases for a new trial with intervenors as party defendants, denied.

Mr. Justice Powell and Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
